_source: Erratum for AV/AVP loci written as DCS sentence indices ('AVŚ, 8, 6.s48' = 48th sentence of hymn 8.6) and read as verse numbers. Built by scripts/build_av_erratum.py from the DCS CoNLL-U headers (sent_counter/sent_subcounter; sent_id '<line>_<k>') via pie.formula_search_multi.dcs_citation_index; stanza counts from the Whitney–Lanman translation shipped with the DCS. This file is the correction for the frozen evaluation set (data/research/formulas/eval-r3/formulas-eval.jsonl) and for the committed 8c packets, claims, verdicts, accepted and novelty files, which are not rewritten. 'cite' is the citation to use; status 'inferred' is a heuristic verse (see _validation): it is in 'cite' only where 'checked' names how it was verified (whitney | literature), otherwise in 'inferred_cite' (not to be cited unchecked); pāda letters are given only for a 2-line stanza with lines of similar length (ab = first DCS line, cd = second).
